articles.title: A Big Election Battle That Could Change Who Runs the Country!
articles.summary: Imagine a small town suddenly deciding the next prime minister! In Makerfield, England, a special election is coming because the current MP stepped aside for Mayor Andy Burnham. But a party called Reform UK is fighting hard to win too.

articles.title: A Huge Train Strike Could Shut Down New York's Commuter Line!
articles.summary: The Long Island Rail Road, which carries 250,000 people every weekday, might shut down because of a strike. Workers and the MTA are arguing over pay raises. If they don't agree by Saturday, trains could stop, and riders might have to use free shuttle buses.

articles.title: Meet the Young Homeowners Beating the Odds in a Crazy Expensive Market!
articles.summary: Francisco Vazquez, 27, bought a three-bedroom home in Milwaukee for $220,000 by saving $72,000 in just over two years. He's part of a small but growing group of Gen Z buyers, who are more likely to buy alone and without parental help than millennials were.
